name: Ecrin Hair Removal Spray for Men & Women | Fast, Gentle Hair Remover 100ml
description:
Ecrin Hair Removal Spray offers quick and effortless hair removal for smooth, silky skin in just 8 minutes. Formulated with gentle ingredients and dermatologist-tested, it removes hair close to the roots without causing irritation, bumps, or scratches. Suitable for both men and women, this spray is ideal for at-home use or on-the-go, delivering soft, hair-free skin with minimal effort.
Key Features
 Fast-acting formula removes hair in just 8 minutes
 Gentle and dermatologist-tested for safe skin use
 Smooths skin without irritation, bumps, or scratches
 Suitable for men and women (unisex)
 Convenient at-home or on-the-go application
 Compact and easy-to-use spray for quick hair removal
How to Use
 Spray evenly onto the desired area
 Wait for 8 minutes
 Wipe off hair with a cloth or tissue
 Avoid using on inflamed, broken, or sensitive skin
 Rinse skin afterward if needed
Material
Gentle hair removal active ingredients, moisturizing agents
Safety Information
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes
 Keep out of reach of children
 Do not use on irritated, inflamed, or sensitive skin
Package Includes
 1 × Ecrin Hair Removal Spray 100mlSpecial Note: Shake well before each useIf you've allergy to skin care chemicals, do not use this product Always perform a patch test on a small area before full application If no reaction occurs, then you may continue applying on the desired area If you experience tingling or burning, add a few drops of mineral water to reduce intensity.
